evidence_state_contract.rule: Every populated context fact distinguishes explicit, inferred, and unresolved state and carries typed source_refs. Numeric or prose confidence is prohibited.

relationship_effect_classes.writing_only: May adjust wording, register, distance, length, or presentation but may not choose or override a decision.
relationship_effect_classes.decision_material: May be proposed as typed input to a future application-owned decision contract; it does not independently select a decision.
relationship_effect_classes.safety_material: Must be handled by a future application-owned Safety or boundary contract before ordinary writing optimization.
relationship_effect_classes.anti_collapse_rule: Relationship context is not globally writing-only. Explicit no-contact, authority, minor status, professional boundaries, coercion, block/restriction, and explicit relationship ending require typed decision or Safety treatment.

romantic_stage.definition: The explicitly supported romantic stage between the user and the other person, independent of social role or familiarity.

allowed_values.none: No romantic frame is supplied or applicable.
allowed_values.new_acquaintance: The parties have only recently met in a potentially romantic context.
allowed_values.dating_before_relationship: They are meeting romantically but no relationship is established.
allowed_values.ambiguous: A romantic possibility is raised but the stage is explicitly unclear.
allowed_values.partner: An established partner relationship is explicitly supplied.
allowed_values.former_partner: A former romantic relationship is explicitly supplied.
allowed_values.unknown: The available evidence does not support a value.

permitted_evidence: an explicit user statement about current or former relationship status
a typed fact with source references that unambiguously states the stage
prohibited_inference: inferring a relationship from affectionate wording alone
inferring reconciliation intent from former-partner status
inferring exclusivity, commitment, or mutual romantic interest without explicit evidence
effect_on_wording: set an evidence-based ceiling on romantic certainty
increase boundary care for former or ambiguous stages
romantic_stage.must_not_affect: The application-owned decision Policy or its allowed decision set.
romantic_stage.unknown_handling: Retain unknown and use candidate voice, incoming register, purpose, and a neutral fallback without inventing romance.

effect_class.rule: Assign from explicit material and source references. A dimension has no permanent class, and a broad relationship chip alone cannot create decision or Safety authority.

writing_only: early acquaintance where no boundary or risk fact is present
decision_material: explicit relationship ending that changes whether contact is appropriate
safety_material: explicit no-contact direction or coercive romantic access

explicit_evidence.rule: Record only evidence directly stated or selected by the user.

inferred_evidence.rule: Keep bounded inference separate from explicit evidence and never infer authority, consent, age, or relationship status from style alone.

unresolved.rule: Use true when available evidence does not support a single typed value.

source_refs.rule: References point to typed evidence locations, never case IDs, expected outputs, or raw database records.

social_role.definition: The non-romantic social role that best describes how the parties know each other.

allowed_values.acquaintance: They know each other lightly but are not described as friends.
allowed_values.close_friend: An established close friendship is explicitly supplied.
allowed_values.school_contact: Their relationship materially involves school or study.
allowed_values.other: A supported role exists outside the listed values.
allowed_values.unknown: The available evidence does not support a value.

permitted_evidence: an explicit description of how the parties know each other
typed work or school context tied to source references
prohibited_inference: treating frequent contact as close friendship
treating work contact as formal hierarchy
treating a broad romantic chip as a complete social role
effect_on_wording: calibrate social distance and topic framing
avoid business-letter tone for a close friend
avoid unsupported personal warmth in work or school contexts
social_role.must_not_affect: The application-owned decision Policy or its allowed decision set.
social_role.unknown_handling: Retain unknown and do not manufacture a role; prefer observed register and neutral distance.

hierarchy.definition: The explicitly supported relative seniority or authority relevant to wording.

allowed_values.user_is_junior: The user is junior or subordinate in the relevant context.
allowed_values.peer: No material hierarchy is supplied between the parties.
allowed_values.user_is_senior: The user is senior or has greater authority in the relevant context.
allowed_values.none: Hierarchy is not applicable to this relationship.
allowed_values.unknown: The available evidence does not support a value.

familiarity.definition: How established the relationship and its communication patterns are, independent of romance and hierarchy.

allowed_values.first_contact: This is the first known direct contact or meeting.
allowed_values.early: Only limited prior interaction is supplied.
allowed_values.developing: Repeated interaction exists but the pattern is not fully established.
allowed_values.established: A stable communication relationship is explicitly supported.
allowed_values.former: The prior relationship is no longer current.
allowed_values.unknown: The available evidence does not support a value.

permitted_evidence: a supplied duration or repeated-contact description
a stated prior relationship that has ended
prohibited_inference: equating message frequency with emotional closeness

equating former familiarity with current access or consent
effect_on_wording: control explanation length and conversational shorthand
reduce unsupported familiarity in early or former relationships
familiarity.must_not_affect: The application-owned decision Policy or its allowed decision set.
familiarity.unknown_handling: Retain unknown and avoid both artificial distance and invented shared history.

allowed_values.private: The exchange is a private personal message.
allowed_values.work: The exchange materially concerns or occurs through work.
allowed_values.school: The exchange materially concerns or occurs through school or study.
allowed_values.mixed: More than one context materially applies.
allowed_values.other: A supported context exists outside the listed values.
allowed_values.unknown: The available evidence does not support a value.

permitted_evidence: an explicit channel or setting statement

observed_register.definition: The register directly observed in the candidate and incoming message, without treating consultation prose as messaging style.

allowed_values.polite: Consistently polite or honorific messaging is observed.
allowed_values.neutral_polite: Ordinary polite messaging without strong formality is observed.
allowed_values.mixed: Polite and casual forms are materially mixed.
allowed_values.unknown: No reliable messaging sample supports a value.

prohibited_inference: using the consultation narrative's explanatory register

observed_register.unknown_handling: Use the candidate if present, otherwise match the incoming message conservatively, then fall back to neutral polite wording.

fields.message_id: stable synthetic or request-local identifier; never a database UUID copied into planning evidence
fields.sequence: nonnegative integer or unknown, ordered within the supplied conversation only

invariants: Do not treat an unsent candidate as already sent.
Do not treat the other person's message as the user's voice sample.
Do not treat consultation narrative as a messaging-style sample.
Do not merge quoted history into the current incoming turn.

fields.unanswered_obligations: typed dialogue-act references requiring a response
fields.practical_requirements: dates, choices, confirmations, or other explicit practical needs without invented values
fields.response_expectation: required, reasonable, optional, absent, or unknown

fields.invitation_specificity: none, vague, bounded, specific, or unknown

candidate_communicative_intent.rule: Preserve candidate meaning and interpersonal load unless a higher-precedence Safety, explicit boundary, user constraint, or required answer demands a material correction.

user_goal_detail.rule: The goal guides wording and fulfillment but cannot override Safety, explicit boundaries, or the application-owned decision.

fields.value: known value or bounded custom explicit constraint

user_constraints.rule: Only explicit constraints are enforceable as user constraints; general advice is not converted into a constraint.

fields.usual_register: polite, neutral_polite, casual, mixed, or unknown
fields.usual_length: terse, short, medium, long, or unknown
fields.usual_initiator: user, other_person, reciprocal, variable, or unknown

communication_pattern.rule: Reflect a pattern only when explicitly supplied. Do not fill missing patterns from general relationship assumptions.

channel_and_timing.exact_time_rule: Do not fabricate an exact time unless explicitly supplied.
channel_and_timing.decision_rule: Channel or relative timing alone does not force send, wait, or do-not-send.

fields.dialect_or_regional_expression: typed expression profile without storing a real user's raw corpus

language_and_expression.rule: Do not normalize established dialect, mixed language, or intentional idiolect into generic standard Japanese; do not preserve probable typos as identity.

repeat_consultation_state.rule: Reassess only material changed facts. Repetition without change must not produce stronger reassurance, worse prediction, or escalating advice.

privacy_markers.storage_rule: Record marker categories only. Raw PII is prohibited in planning assets, logs, errors, inspection artifacts, and persistent style profiles.
privacy_markers.minimization_rule: Do not reproduce a marked value in a draft or report unless strictly required for the user's explicit communicative purpose.

unknown_rule: When a field is not supplied, keep it unknown. Do not complete context from stereotypes or general relationship advice.
